key: # XRVision sound table. Game code reports what happened; this file says what it sounds like.
# There is no audio code outside modules/audio — adding a sound means adding a row here.
# key      dotted. "pressed.hello" falls back to "pressed". Left column = things that happen.
# sound    res:// clip, or tone:<hz> / tone:<hz>/<ms> for a generated placeholder beep.
#          Notes joined by + play in turn, 0 Hz is a rest: tone:660/90+0/40+880/200.
#          Several separated by | are variations. Empty = still fall back (a row to fill in).
#          A single - means silent, and stops the fallback.
# options  space in between: vol=-6  pitch=0.9-1.1  bus=voice|sfx|ambience  space=2d|3d
# Saving this file takes effect within a second while the game runs from the editor.
# Mistakes (unknown option, missing clip, duplicate key) are printed at load and fail tools\test.cmd.
# Keys the game sent that are not here are printed as AUDIO_UNMAPPED and listed in the Test Room.

note: every button in the game, at the button
a named button's own sound (the sound-table test uses it as its example)
Test Room: RUN ALL
Test Room: RESET

key: # ===== feedback (Events.judge: one sound, one shape mark, one vibration; never colour alone) =====
# Good and bad differ in rhythm and length as well as pitch, so they are told apart by anyone.

note: three quick notes going up: yes!
two slow notes going down: oh-oh. Gentle, never a buzzer
a sparkling run: something earned
the menu opens: two notes up
the menu closes: the same two notes, down
a task taken on from the menu: "let's go"
bought in the shop; plays under feedback.reward, so it is the low half
an item comes out of the bag into the hand: up
an item goes back into the bag: down
picking anything up
the ball among the Find It objects
furniture set down and settled
a creature caught; three notes so three in a row do not sound the same
one flew away

key: # The search trial also carries its own clips (SearchTrial.correct_sound / wrong_sound).
# Those play through Events.play_at and do not come through this table.

note: right object picked
round lost
wrong object picked; the round goes on
quiet for now: the guide naming the object is the cue. Put a "listen" sound here when one is recorded
quiet for now, except the search rows above: catching a butterfly already sounds on "caught"
any task finished
anything granted
the Magic Stone: the thing the whole loop is for
quiet for now: the guide reads the first step out. Put a "new task" sting here when one is recorded
arriving at a place or station on the island: a soft "you're here"
a trial run reached the number of rounds the task asked for
a spirit ability switched on or off
B / Y. The guide repeating the line is the feedback

key: # ===== ambience (one loop per level, swapped when the level changes) =====
# Needs real recordings to be worth switching on; tones would be unbearable in a loop.

note: no bed anywhere until there are recordings
birds, wind and small waves
the task self-test fact
Test Room: the Audio table station. Its own row so the shared "pressed" cooldown cannot swallow it
